note: Chat inside the Brotherhood (docs/HLD_BROTHERHOOD_CHAT_2026-10-03.md, TABOO 0.031). Players of one organisation talk in short words and radio phrases, like a team chat; there are no outside messengers, no voice, no rewards for talking, and nothing is written to disk. Every phrase carries its meaning for the text version (TABOO 0.39).

phrases.meaning: I take the step first; the others may follow.
I keep this place; do not worry about it.
Not yet; the water must settle.
A request for help, never a demand.
A clue is here; come and read it.
Joy that another finished what was begun (IX.1).
Going up no faster than ten metres a minute.
The base protocol of every channel (VI.11).
